Rule 67:10:07:06 Protective payee for minor parent not living with parent, legal guardian, or adult relative. CHAPTER 67:10:07

          67:10:07:06.  Protective payee for minor parent not living with parent, legal guardian, or adult relative. If a minor parent is not living with a parent, legal guardian, or adult relative, the department shall appoint a protective payee to manage the assistance payment.

          Source: 24 SDR 24, effective August 31, 1997.

          General Authority: SDCL 28-7A-3(7).

          Law Implemented: SDCL 28-7A-3(7).

          Cross-References: Eligibility restrictions for a parent under age 18, § 67:10:01:14; Exceptions to eligibility requirements for parents  under age 18, § 67:10:01:15.
